finding: Gboard showed a clipboard paste-suggestion chip (the current system clipboard item; the host clipboard changed during the run, so the two chips show different items) above the SearchBar in 2 of 210 distinct F2 frames. The chip is absent from all UI XML, logs, receipts, the checkpoint and the run stream (text search of every non-PNG file found no clipboard content). capture-index.json keeps the executor's pre-redaction hashes; sha256After below is authoritative for the committed PNGs.
detection: Coordinator visual inspection of all 210 distinct F2 frames via 18 contact sheets, then full-resolution crops of y 150-350 px for the two chip frames. All other frames, including every other SearchBar-focused frame (F2-K-*, F2-R02-*, F2-R03-*, *-settled*-enter, *-return-top), show only the floating Gboard toolbar with no clipboard content.
originals: Unredacted originals were moved outside version control to the git-ignored /_backup_ns07_redaction/f-device/ folder (*.unredacted.png); they are never committed.
